Traditional tale: 孟母三迁

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. At “孟子老是祭拜,” show that he is copying what he sees and add his mood: “孟子一边笑一边学别人祭拜。”
2. After “都很小,” add Mengzi’s reaction to make the setting feel more personal: “孟子看着学校，觉得有一点失望。”
3. Add a short line of speech after the description of the schools: “这儿的学校怎么这么小？”

ideas.reason: It concretely shows that Mengzi is imitating the funeral rituals he sees near the cemetery.
